attempted_claim: Prove or disprove that for the same 2D i.i.d. uniform-[1/2,2] ensemble, with the random minimal scale r_*(0) defined as the smallest r>=1 (or +infinity if none exists) such that for every R>=r and every u with -div(a grad u)=0 in Q_R=(-R/2,R/2]^2 cap Z^2 the tilt-corrected excess Exc(r)=inf_{p in R^2} fint_{Q_r}|grad u-p|^2 satisfies Exc(R/4)<=(1/2)*Exc(R), there exist deterministic C,c>0 such that P(r_*>R)<=C*exp(-c*R) for all R>=1. A complete resolution is either a rigorous proof of this pure-exponential tail improving the known stretched-exponential form, or a rigorous proof that no such exponential tail holds, e.g. a rare-event lower bound of stretched-exponential type along a subsequence.
decisive_failure: The lane attempted both the concentration upper-bound route and the rare-patch lower-bound route and documented concrete structural blockers for each, but produced no proof, disproof, or independently valuable original increment; the diagnostic Hoeffding-versus-Meyers contrast and capacity heuristic are standard tools, not auditable new results.
